dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, are you packing a suitcase?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ər juː ˈpækɪŋ ə ˈsuːtkeɪs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. I'm going to visit my aunt in Chiang Mai.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈvɪzɪt maɪ ˈænt ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Are you going to go by plane?
dialogue.reading: ər juː ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈɡoʊ baɪ ˈpleɪn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, I'm not. We're going to go by train. Are you going to graduate next year, Emma?
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪm ˈnɑːt. wɪr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈɡoʊ baɪ ˈtreɪn. ər juː ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈɡrædʒueɪt ˈnɛkst ˈjɪr, ˈɛmə?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, I am. Then I'm going to work abroad.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈæm. ˈðɛn aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈwɜːrk əˈbrɔːd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? Are you going to work in Thailand?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ər juː ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈwɜːrk ɪn ˈtaɪlænd?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Maybe! I'm not going to go home to Canada. I love it here.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi! aɪm ˈnɑːt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈɡoʊ ˈhoʊm tə ˈkænədə. aɪ ˈlʌv ɪt ˈhɪr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! Then you can visit my family in Bangkok!
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ˈðɛn juː kən ˈvɪzɪt maɪ ˈfæməli ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk!
